mapper.select: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(DATE_ADD(STR_TO_DATE(#{targetDate}, '%Y%m%d%H'), interval ${start} hour), '%Y%m%d%H') AS startDate, DATE_FORMAT(DATE_ADD(STR_TO_DATE(#{targetDate}, '%Y%m%d%H'), interval ${end} hour), '%Y%m%d%H') AS endDate
SELECT CTIME FROM UI_USAGE_COMPARE ORDER BY CTIME DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT CTIME AS ctime, DATE_TIME AS dateTime, DATE_DAY_OF_WEEK AS dateDayOfWeek, AVG(CASE WHEN b.DATE IS NULL THEN IN_MAIL ELSE 0 END) AS inMail, AVG(CASE WHEN b.DATE IS NULL THEN OUT_MAIL ELSE 0 END) AS outMail, AVG(CASE WHEN b.DATE IS NULL THEN FILE_SIZE ELSE 0 END) AS fileSize, AVG(CASE WHEN b.DATE IS NULL THEN FTP ELSE 0 END) AS ftp, AVG(CASE WHEN b.DATE IS NULL THEN TOTAL_SIZE ELSE 0 END) AS totalSize FROM UI_USAGE_COMPARE a LEFT OUTER JOIN UI_HOLIDAY b ON CONCAT(a.DATE_MONTH, a.DATE_DAY) = b.DATE AND a.DATE_DAY_OF_WEEK IN (2, 3, 4, 5, 6) WHERE CTIME >= #{startDate} AND CTIME <= #{endDate} GROUP BY CTIME, DATE_TIME, DATE_DAY_OF_WEEK ORDER BY CTIME, DATE_TIME

SELECT MAX(CTIME) AS ctime, DATE_MONTH AS dateMonth, DATE_DAY AS dateDay, DATE_DAY_OF_WEEK AS dateDayOfWeek, SUM(CASE WHEN b.DATE IS NULL THEN IN_MAIL ELSE 0 END) AS inMail, SUM(CASE WHEN b.DATE IS NULL THEN OUT_MAIL ELSE 0 END) AS outMail, SUM(CASE WHEN b.DATE IS NULL THEN FILE_SIZE ELSE 0 END) AS fileSize, SUM(CASE WHEN b.DATE IS NULL THEN FTP ELSE 0 END) AS ftp, SUM(CASE WHEN b.DATE IS NULL THEN TOTAL_SIZE ELSE 0 END) AS totalSize FROM UI_USAGE_COMPARE a LEFT OUTER JOIN UI_HOLIDAY b ON CONCAT(a.DATE_MONTH, a.DATE_DAY) = b.DATE AND a.DATE_DAY_OF_WEEK IN (2, 3, 4, 5, 6) WHERE CTIME >= #{startDate} AND CTIME <= #{endDate} GROUP BY DATE_MONTH, DATE_DAY, DATE_DAY_OF_WEEK ORDER BY DATE_MONTH, DATE_DAY

SELECT MAX(CTIME) AS ctime, DATE_MONTH AS dateMonth, SUM(CASE WHEN b.DATE IS NULL THEN IN_MAIL ELSE 0 END) AS inMail, SUM(CASE WHEN b.DATE IS NULL THEN OUT_MAIL ELSE 0 END) AS outMail, SUM(CASE WHEN b.DATE IS NULL THEN FILE_SIZE ELSE 0 END) AS fileSize, SUM(CASE WHEN b.DATE IS NULL THEN FTP ELSE 0 END) AS ftp, SUM(CASE WHEN b.DATE IS NULL THEN TOTAL_SIZE ELSE 0 END) AS totalSize FROM UI_USAGE_COMPARE a LEFT OUTER JOIN UI_HOLIDAY b ON CONCAT(a.DATE_MONTH, a.DATE_DAY) = b.DATE AND a.DATE_DAY_OF_WEEK IN (2, 3, 4, 5, 6) WHERE CTIME >= #{startDate} AND CTIME <= #{endDate} GROUP BY DATE_MONTH ORDER BY DATE_MONTH

SELECT MAX(CTIME) AS ctime, DATE_MONTH AS dateMonth, DATE_WEEK_OF_MONTH AS dateWeekOfMonth, SUM(CASE WHEN b.DATE IS NULL THEN IN_MAIL ELSE 0 END) AS inMail, SUM(CASE WHEN b.DATE IS NULL THEN OUT_MAIL ELSE 0 END) AS outMail, SUM(CASE WHEN b.DATE IS NULL THEN FILE_SIZE ELSE 0 END) AS fileSize, SUM(CASE WHEN b.DATE IS NULL THEN FTP ELSE 0 END) AS ftp, SUM(CASE WHEN b.DATE IS NULL THEN TOTAL_SIZE ELSE 0 END) AS totalSize FROM UI_USAGE_COMPARE a LEFT OUTER JOIN UI_HOLIDAY b ON CONCAT(DATE_MONTH, DATE_DAY) = b.DATE AND a.DATE_DAY_OF_WEEK IN (2, 3, 4, 5, 6) WHERE CTIME >= #{startDate} AND CTIME <= #{endDate} GROUP BY DATE_MONTH, DATE_WEEK_OF_MONTH ORDER BY DATE_MONTH, DATE_WEEK_OF_MONTH
mapper.insert:
REPLACE INTO UI_USAGE_COMPARE (CTIME, DATE_MONTH, DATE_DAY, DATE_TIME, DATE_WEEK_OF_MONTH, DATE_DAY_OF_WEEK, IN_MAIL, OUT_MAIL, FILE_SIZE, FTP, TOTAL_SIZE) VALUES
(#{item.ctime}, #{item.dateMonth}, #{item.dateDay}, #{item.dateTime}, #{item.dateWeekOfMonth}, #{item.dateDayOfWeek}, #{item.inMail}, #{item.outMail}, #{item.fileSize}, #{item.ftp}, #{item.totalSize})
